text:
alex.m: Heads-up — saw 4x GPU nodes spin up in eu-west this morning right after the training-worker rollout. Cost spike on the bill.
oncall-bot: Incident detected: rapid scale-up in cluster eu-west-1a (GPU pool). Notifying eng-infra.
maya: That was my deploy. I pushed a change adding podAntiAffinity at hostname level to avoid co-locating GPU jobs.
tj: That sounds like it could force pods to spread across nodes and cause CA to scale up. Do we need hostname-level anti-affinity for that workload?
maya: We wanted strict isolation because the job uses a shared local NVMe cache and we saw IO blips when two jobs landed on the same node.
samir: Two problems: (1) hostname anti-affinity forces one pod per node -> high node count for N replicas, (2) cluster-autoscaler will add nodes to satisfy scheduling and then scale down later if utilization low -> oscillation.
lina: Can we switch to preferred podAntiAffinity (preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) with topologyKey: zone instead of hostname? That would spread across zones but allow co-location if capacity constrained.
maya: Agree that sounds reasonable. Example we could use:
```yaml
podAntiAffinity:
  preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
  - weight: 50
    podAffinityTerm:
      topologyKey: kubernetes.io/zone
      labelSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: training-worker
```
This keeps some spreading but doesn't force every replica onto a separate node.
alex.m: Also check taints/tolerations — our GPU pool nodes have `gpu=true:NoSchedule`. The pods have tolerations but we also had nodeAffinity requiring `node-role=exclusive-gpu`. If affinity is too strict + hostname anti-affinity, CA had no option but to add more nodes in that pool.
tj: Another mitigation: use topologySpreadConstraints with maxSkew to bound distribution instead of hard anti-affinity.
samir: From CA side, we should increase `scale-down-unneeded-time` to avoid rapid churn (default 10m). Also enable `--balance-similar-node-groups`? The oscillation looked like new nodes coming up then getting terminated in next window.
infra-bot: Note: Reserved GPU capacity for eu-west is limited this week due to quota; scaling up hit quota and then fallback to other zones, increasing cross-zone traffic.
lina: Action items: maya to open PR to change anti-affinity to preferred + zone topology; infra to propose CA tweak (scale-down-unneeded-time to 20m and check expander); alex.m to add a fallback that allows co-location when local NVMe cache is free (simple startup probe). We'll monitor for 24h.
maya: On it, I'll target a canary change (small weight) and roll it to training-worker canary first.
alex.m: Thanks — let's also add a short postmortem note if we see another cost blip. :eyes:
